# git: alias: improve amend with GIT_COMMITTER_DATE

Keep the commit dates when amending. **Motivation:** `git commit --amend` resets the committer date to now, which moves the commit in GitHub's contribution calendar and "worsens experience with GitHub" — the whole point of the dated commits made with `git at`/`git contrib` is lost by a later `git amend`.

```
$ ts=git --no-pager log -1 --format="%as"
$ GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=$ts git commit --amend --no-edit
```
